senses.gloss:
पर्ण् पर्ण् (more properly regarded as
a Nom. fr. पर्ण below), cl. 10. P.
पर्णयति, -यितुम्, to be green or verdant.

पर्ण, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. पॄ), a pinion,
feather, wing; the feather of an arrow; a leaf (re-
garded as the plumage of a tree); the Pān or betel
leaf; (अस्), m. Butea Frondosa (a beautiful sacred
tree with leaves from eight to sixteen inches in length,
of the wood of which particular sacrificial vessels
are made, in later times generally called पलाश);
N. of a man; of a teacher; of a place; (ई), f. an
aquatic plant, Pistia Stratiotes; the leaf of the Asa
Fœtida (?); [cf. अच्छिन्न-प्˚, अश्व-प्˚, उत्तान-प्˚,
&c.; cf. probably Gr. Πάρνης, Παρνασός,
Παρνασσός; perhaps Lat. penna, if not fr. rt. पत्,
q. v., frons; Old Germ. farn; Angl. Sax. fearn.]
—पर्ण-कार, अस्, m. = वार-जीवी (commonly वा-
rui), a vender of betel leaves.
—पर्ण-कुटिका, f.
or पर्ण-कुटी, f. a hut made of leaves.
—पर्ण-
कृच्छ्र, अस्, m. ‘leaf-penance,’ living for a time
upon an infusion of leaves and Kuśa grass as a religious
observance.
—पर्ण-खण्ड, अस्, m. a tree without
apparent blossoms; a tree in general.
—पर्ण-चीर-
पट, अस्, आ, अम्, clad in a garment made of strips
of leaves; an epithet of Śiva.
—पर्ण-चोरक, अस्,
m. a kind of perfume; [cf. चोरक.]
—पर्ण-धि,
इस्, m., Ved. the part of an arrow to which the
feathers are fastened.
—पर्ण-ध्वस्, त्, त्, त्, causing
the falling of leaves.
—पर्ण-नर, अस्, m. ‘man
of leaves,’ an effigy stuffed with leaves or the figure
of a man made of leaves and burnt in place of a lost
corpse.
—पर्ण-नाल, अस्, m. a leaf-stalk, petiole.
—पर्ण-प्रात्यिक, N. of a locality (perhaps in-
correctly for पर्ण-प्रासिक).
—पर्ण-भेदिनी, f.
the Priyaṅgu tree.
—पर्ण-भोजन, अस्, आ, अम्,
feeding upon leaves; (अस्), m. any animal eating
leaves, a goat.
—पर्ण-मणि, इस्, m., Ved. a kind
of magical instrument (made of the wood of the
Parṇa tree ?).
—पर्ण-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. made
of the wood of the Butea Frondosa.
—पर्ण-
माचाल, अस्, m. the plant Averrhoa Carambola (=
कर्मरङ्ग).
—पर्ण-मुच्, ट्, ट्, ट्, causing leaves
to fall (as the wind).
—पर्ण-मृग, अस्, m. ‘leaf-
animal,’ any wild animal lodging in the boughs of
trees (as a monkey, sloth, squirrel, &c.).
—पर्ण-
रुह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, causing the leaves to grow (as the
wind).
—पर्ण-लता, f. the betel plant.
—पर्ण-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, abounding in leaves, leafy.
—पर्ण-
वल्क, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—पर्ण-वल्ली, f. Butea
Frondosa (= पलाशी-लता).
—पर्ण-वाद्य, अम्,
n. ‘leaf-music,’ sounds produced by blowing into a
leaf.
—पर्ण-वी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. ‘wing-borne,’
carried by wings.
—पर्ण-वीटिका, f. the Areca nut
cut in pieces, sprinkled with spices, and rolled up
in betel leaves.
—पर्ण-शद or पर्ण-शाद, अस्,
m., Ved. the falling of leaves.
—पर्ण-शद्य, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. relating to the falling of leaves.
—पर्-
ण-शय्या, f. a couch of leaves, leafy couch.
—पर्ण-
शर, अस्, m., Ved. a leaf-stalk, petiole; the stalk of
a Parṇa leaf.
—पर्ण-शवर, आस्, m., N. of a
people, (Śavaras living upon leaves.)
—पर्ण-शाला,
f. ‘leaf-hut,’ an arbour or hut made of leaves and
grass, hermitage; N. of a great settlement of
Brāhmans between the Yamunā and Gaṅgā in
Madhya-deśa.
—पर्णशालाग्र (˚ला-अग्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of a mountain in Bhadrāśva.
—पर्ण-शुष्, ट्,
ट्, ट्, drying or shriveling the leaves (as the wind).
[]
—पर्ण-संस्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, having leaves for
a bed, sleeping on leaves.
—पर्ण-सन्तर, अस्, आ,
अम्, having leaves for a bed, sleeping on leaves.
—पर्णाढक (˚ण-आढ्˚), अस्, m., N. of a man;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants.
—पर्णाद
(˚ण-अद), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding upon leaves; (अस्),
m., N. of an ancient sage; of a Brāhman.
—पर्णा-
शन (˚ण-अश्˚), अम्, n. feeding on leaves; (अस्), m.
a cloud.
—पर्णासि (˚ण-असि), इस्, m. a species of
basil with small leaves, Ocymum Sanctum.
—पर्-
णाहार (˚ण-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding upon leaves.
—पर्णोटज (˚ण-उट्˚), अम्, n. ‘leaf-hut,’ an an-
chorite's hut or cottage, a hermitage.
—पर्णोत्स
(˚ण-उत्˚), अस्, m., N. of a village.

पार्ण पार्ण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पर्ण), made
or consisting of leaves, leafy; raised from leaves (as
a tax); made of the wood of the Butea Frondosa;
(अस्), m. a patronymic.

पर्णक, अस्, m., Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara)
= भिल्ल, q. v.; N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of
his descendants; (इका), f. a kind of vegetable; N. of
an Apsaras.

पर्णय, अस्, m., Ved., N. of an enemy (according
to Sāy. an Asura) slain by Indra.
—पर्णय-घ्न,
अम्, n., Ved. the slaying of Parṇaya.

पर्णल, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in leaves, full of
leaves, leafy.

पर्णाल पर्णाल, अस्, m. a boat; a spade
or hoe; single combat.
पर्णिक, अस्, आ, अम्, selling or dealing in Parṇī.
पर्णिल, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in leaves, leafy.
पर्ण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to leaves, leafy.

पार्णवल्कि, इस्, m. (fr. पर्ण-वल्क), a patro-
nymic of Ni-gada.
